errors.text: The hypothesis substitutes a W-Ni-Fe-Ta refractory alloy for the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic alloy, so it does not establish applicability to the specified brittle FCC/B2 lamellar system.
It replaces the required 6 GPa, 1473 K HPHT treatment with cold rolling, annealing, and aging; therefore, it cannot reconstruct or directly test the pressure-induced hierarchical transformation.
The proposed falsification experiment lacks a matched high-temperature, low-pressure control needed to distinguish the target HPHT effect from conventional thermal treatment.
